title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra review: The ultra foldable with an ultra price
summary: The Z Fold 8 Ultra is not a big leap, but it continues Samsung’s pattern of iterative foldable improvements. As of the last version of One UI (and continuing in the version on the Fold), Samsung’s phone app does Google-style call screening.
